Interface TelemetryEntry

public interface TelemetryEntry
Interface for individual telemetry entries. Intended for use by backends; most users should use the TelemetryTable class.

Implementations must not throw from logging, metadata, or discard-checking methods. Recoverable failures should be reported through TelemetryRegistry.reportWarning(String, String) and skipped.

Methods on the same entry may be called concurrently. Implementations must copy mutable input they retain after a method returns.
